title: DateTimePicker
description: Fiori date-time picker: calendar and clocks side by side with OK / Cancel.

usage.summary: Enter one localized Gregorian date and time together.
useWhen: Let users specify both a date and a time for one event in a single field.
Allow manual entry as well as calendar and clock selection; provide timezone context separately when needed.
Set formatPattern, minDate and maxDate to match the required precision and valid date-time bounds.

avoidWhen.when: Enter a date without a time.
Enter a time without a date.
Enter a start and end date as one interval.
Select dates in a permanently visible calendar without entering a time.
Enter plain text without date or time parsing, or compose a custom picker with caller-owned value rules.
